correctness.rationale: PASS: The absorbing zero itself is an idempotent, so it belongs to generated subsemigroup; for each edge there is exactly one nonzero idempotent. Spanning-forest gauge normalization removes tree labels and leaves β_C=e_C-v_C+1 independent uniform F_p^d cycle gains. Products of idempotents realize one affine coset of their span for every reachable left/right pair; no cross-component nonzero products. Therefore the exact size law 1+sum_C a_C b_C p^{rank(d x β_C)} and the connected/full-rank criterion hold, including isolated vertices and β=0. Independent small finite check: for a complete 2x3 support, p=2,d=2, β=2, there are (4-1)(4-2)=6 full-rank 2x2 matrices, each with 4^4 tree-label choices, hence 1536 of 4096 edge-labelings succeed, matching source. In balanced Bernoulli support θ=(log N+c)/N, prescribed l left/r right isolated vertices forbid N(l+r)-lr edges. Joint factorial moments give independent Pois(e^-c) isolated counts. Connectivity given no isolates follows a spanning-tree component union bound; centered edge count has binomial CLT and mixed conditional characteristic functions show asymptotic independence. β=M-2N+1 and d=floor(Eβ+t sd(M)); random-matrix deficiency tends to 0 above t and is impossible below, yielding exp(-2e^-c)(1-Phi(t)). This last limit is analytic, not inferred from finite checks.
